'''1999 Who Got Game? tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Phoenix, Arizona in October 1999. [[Michael Girard]] won it. It is known from Michael Girard's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d85">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-10-25-tr-who-got-gamed85/ tr-who-got-game], DeckTech (Michael "Dvader" Girard, 25 October 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-10-25-tr-who-got-gamed85/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' October 1999
* '''Site:''' Phoenix, Arizona
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 21
* '''Winner:''' [[Michael Girard]]
